## What this region is

The @inixiative/permissions library: a generic rebac / abac / rbac core made of a small permix grant wrapper and a relationship-walking check engine over json-rules, with the relation resolver injected and record hydration left to the app.

## What it exists for

- Build or run a permission check
- Check permissions that walk relations
- Widen permissions on a single record

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Who is allowed to hit this endpoint → permissions-roles
- Which table holds the membership → tenancy
- Is this rule well-formed before I save it → json-rules
- Which builder hook do I use → rules-builder
